item.title: How I Configure LLMs on a Budget (in Brazil)
item.author: contact@vmmazz.com (Victor Mota Mazzei)
item.description: The goal of this post is to share how I configured my OpenCode setup to get the best cost-to-performance ratio I&rsquo;ve found so far. Before we get started, here&rsquo;s a bit of context. At the moment I have three subscriptions: two OpenCode Go subscriptions and one OpenAI Go subscription. Altogether, I spend around R$130 per month. In Brazil, that&rsquo;s still a fairly significant expense, but it&rsquo;s something I&rsquo;ve already factored into my monthly budget.
